MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  NOVEMBER 5, 2018

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by CHAIR
  MEDAWAR.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR MEDAWAR led those in attendance in the Pledge of Allegiance

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Edler, Carman, Scott, Medawar, Zigrang, Schachter,
  Yoo

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Director Wahba, Sr. Planner Naughton,
  Associate Planner Thom, and Administrative
  Assistant Corea

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER EDLER to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES OF OCTOBER 1, 2018 AS
  PRESENTED.

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER To,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-15-18; APPLICANT: PALOS VERDES LIBRARY
  DISTRICT; LOCATION: 701 SILVER SPUR ROAD; A request for a minor addition to the
  existing Peninsula Center Library to accommodate a multipurpose room, known as the
  Annex.

  Sr. Planner Naughton presented Planning Application No. 15-18 and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation on the proposal, and summarized the staff report.

  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission
  approve the Precise Plan of Design for the minor addition to the existing library, to
  accommodate a multipurpose room, known as the Annex.

  Charles Crouse, Facility Manager, Palos Verdes Library District, provided a PowerPoint
  presentation with details on the proposed project, information on funding sources, and an
  overview of the schedule going forward. He also highlighted that all projects at the Palos

Planning Commission Meeting  1
Minutes, November 5, 2018
   Verdes Library District are sustainable and provided a list of these elements for the Annex
  project. In addition there are plans to install Electric Vehicle charging stations.

  CHAIR MEDAWAR stated that it provides a very appealing entrance to the building and
  asked if there is access to the Annex from the inside of the library. Mr. Crouse stated that
  they like that there is no access from the library, so that events taking place after library
  hours would remain separate, for example, the air conditioning will be run separately from
  that of the library. Currently, if there is an event in a meeting room, the entire buildings air
  conditioning is in use.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN thanked the Mr. Crouse, volunteers, and staff for bringing
  this project to the community and stated that this is a great contribution.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER CARMAN to,

  APPROVE THE PRECISE PLAN OF DESIGN FOR THE MINOR ADDITION TO
  THE EXISTING LIBRARY, TO ACCOMMODATE A MULTIPURPOSE ROOM,
  KNOWN AS THE ANNEX.

  AYES:  EDLER, CARMAN, SCOTT, MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, SCHACHTER, YOO
  NOES:
  ABSTAIN:
  ABSENT:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for the item.

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-19-18; APPLICATION: LORIN MIESSE; LOCATION:
  2 BRANDING IRON LANE; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination to
  construct one-story additions to a single-story residence. A Variance is requested to
  encroach into the required front yard beyond the forwardmost building line. A second
  Variance is requested to decrease the front yard area by more than 10%. A Grading
  Application is required for a landscape berm.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER recused himself.

  Associate Planner Thom presented Planning Application No. 19-18 and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation summarizing the staff report. She noted that the current code
  allows access from the interior of the home to the ADU.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission,
  open the public hearing; take public testimony; discuss the issues; close the public
  hearing; and adopt Resolution No. PA-19-18 approving the project.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT commented that this property is along Palos Verdes Drive
  North (PVDN) and within the scenic corridor according to the General Plan and stated that
  there should be special sensitivity to view impacts. COMMISSIONER SCOTT expressed
  his concern with the size of the proposed residence. He also asked why it was not
  silhouetted. Planning Director Wahba stated that the main reason is due to it being a
  single-story home and stated that this home is low slung with no known views from
  neighboring properties. COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that considering the size of the
  lot, he does not see any unique circumstances to approve going beyond the front yard
  setback. COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that the ADU is integrated into the house and
  would like the City Attorney’s view of what makes a fully integrated piece of the home an
  ADU.

  CHAIR MEDAWAR opened the public hearing.

  Mr. Bruce Grimes, 6 Branding Iron Lane, provided two slides, which include historical
  bird’s eye views of the city and another of how the lots were split around the subject area
  and history on the original home being discussed. Mr. Grimes stated that he is in favor of
  this project.

Planning Commission Meeting  2
Minutes, November 5, 2018
   COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN stated that there is very little information on the exterior
  treatments of the home. She stated that questions remain how the character of the
  residences will be maintained on the street. COMMISSIONER CARMAN expressed her
  concern with the scenic corridor on PVDN as well as the overall size and requested that
  the applicant provide additional details on the project.

  VICE CHAIR ZIGRANG agreed with COMMISSIONER SCOTT and stated that the plan is
  not good and stated that the house is being cut into too much and he is not ready to
  approve this project with the garage being in the proposed location.

  COMMISSIONER YOO asked what the standard is for silhouetting a home. Planning
  Director Wahba stated it is required for proposals with two-stories and anything else is on
  a case-by-case basis where there are view corridors. COMMISSIONER YOO suggested
  that the applicant silhouette the location of the garage.

  CHAIR MEDAWAR is concerned with access to the ADU. Planning Director Wahba stated
  that the policy is that homes should not be larger than 5,000 sq. ft. in the city plus the ADU;
  and detaching the ADU could be worse visually. COMMISSIONER SCOTT expressed his
  concern with the mass of this home and the length along Palos Verdes Drive North. More
  dimensions are needed in order to review this project.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that dimensions are needed on the plans, address that
  the ADU is fully integrated into the house, and get the opinion of the City Attorney if this
  proposal has to be viewed as an ADU.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER CARMAN to,

  CONTINUE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 19-18 TO A DATE UNCERTAIN.

  Ayes:  Edler, Carman, Scott, Medawar, Zigrang, Yoo
  Noes:
  Abstain:  Schachter
  Absent:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that this item has been continued to a date uncertain and
  will be re-noticed prior to coming back to the Planning Commission.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None

  10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Planning Director Wahba confirmed dates for the following meetings/events:

  December 3rd – Last Planning Commission meeting of 2018.
  December 13th – Holiday Party
  December 1st – PVP Holiday Parade of Lights

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, OCTOBER 23, 2018

  B.  DRAFT MINUTES OF THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION, OCTOBER 15, 2018

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion to,

   RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A AND 11-B

  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR MEDAWAR adjourned the meeting at 8:03 p.m. The next Planning Commission
  meeting will be held on Monday, December 3, 2018.

  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Heidi Luce, City Clerk
